preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^4, inclusive.
The size of arrays A and B is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The elements of arrays A and B are within the range of -10^14 to 10^14, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The sum of the sizes of arrays A and B over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: Output is -1 if it is impossible to convert A into B
postconditions.description: If the transformation is not possible, the output is -1.

postconditions.expression: Output is the minimum number of operations required to convert A into B
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of operations required to transform array A into array B.

invariants.expression: All operations are either type 1 or type 2
invariants.description: Each operation is either a prefix increment or a suffix increment.

invariants.expression: Operations are performed on the entire array or on a prefix or suffix
invariants.description: The operations are performed on the entire array or on a contiguous subarray.

invariants.expression: The final array A equals array B
invariants.description: After all operations, the array A is equal to the array B.
